'''Plum Pudding''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

==Bundles==
One Plum Pudding may be used as one of the options for the {{Bundle|Winter Star||y}}.

==Tailoring==
Plum Pudding is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Short Jacket]].  [[File:Shirt271a.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Plum Pudding is not used in any [[quests]].
